---
title: "Computer Vision Dojo"
subtitle: "A geometric way"
---

Hands-on notebooks in geometric computer vision: projective geometry of the plane,
homography estimation, rectification, robust fitting, matching. Every notebook is
paired with an algorithm from the accompanying notes, runs top to bottom with no
setup, and opens in Colab with one click.

By [Luca Magri](https://magrilu.github.io/), Politecnico di Milano.

## Start here

- [Affine rectification](notebooks/04-rectification/affine.ipynb) — vanishing points,
  the vanishing line, and the homography that restores parallelism.
